lines.cap: Don't call him an ass. He's smarter than you think.
lines.say: Don't call him an ass. He's smarter than you think.

lines.cap: Donkeys have a reputation. Stubborn. Lazy. Dumb.
lines.say: Donkeys have a reputation. Stubborn. Lazy. Dumb.

lines.cap: But when a donkey stops and refuses to move, it isn't being stubborn.
lines.say: But when a donkey stops and refuses to move, it isn't being stubborn.

lines.cap: It's thinking. A horse runs from danger. A donkey freezes, and works out if it's safe.
lines.say: It's thinking. A horse runs from danger. A donkey freezes, and works out if it's safe.

lines.cap: If it doesn't feel safe, no amount of pulling will change its mind. That's self-preservation, not stupidity.
lines.say: If it doesn't feel safe, no amount of pulling will change its mind. That's self-preservation, not stupidity.

lines.cap: They have great memories too. They can remember places, and other donkeys, for years.
lines.say: They have great memories too. They can remember places, and other donkeys, for years.

lines.cap: And that loud bray? In the desert, it helps them find each other over long distances.
lines.say: And that loud bray? In the desert, it helps them find each other over long distances.

lines.cap: So he's not an ass. He just thinks before he moves.
lines.say: So he's not an ass. He just thinks before he moves.
